name: Seated Front Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise one or both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep a slight elbow bend and don't swing the torso.
Lower slowly. Isolates the front delts.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Seated Front Raise is a beginner pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with dumbbells. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
